messages:
Maria Lopez: Hi team — Maria here, joining as Product Designer (they/she). Quick heads up: I clicked the Figma invite and it spins on the SSO redirect. Anyone hit this?
Samir Patel: Welcome Maria! :tada: Haven't seen that in a bit. @Chen any idea what can cause an infinite redirect?
Chen Park: Hey Maria, welcome! :wave: Usually that's SSO enforcing the org account while your browser is trying to use a personal session. Can you tell me which email you used to accept the invite? Also try clearing cookies or opening an incognito window for a quick workaround.
Maria Lopez: Used maria.lopez@gmail.com initially (I didn't realize we needed the work email). Tried incognito and it loads the file but then it asks for org access.
Robin Alvarez: We prefer folks use the @redwood.com invite link. I'm adding you to the Product Notion space and the roadmap page now. For Figma, Chen should change your invite to the org user.
Chen Park: Ok I revoked the personal invite and re-sent an SSO invite to maria.lopez@redwood.com. You should get a new email. If it still redirects, DM me and I'll add you via SCIM group temporarily.
Maria Lopez: Got the new invite and it worked. Thanks! I can see the "Redwood UI Kit" and "Product exploration" file.
Samir Patel: For the first week, you probably want edit access to your exploration file and viewer on the shared libraries until we sync. @Chen can toggle editor on the exploration file.
Chen Park: Done — granted Editor on "Product exploration - Maria" and Viewer on the libraries for now. Added you to the #design-system channel and invited you to the Figma org team.
Maria Lopez: Great. One more: where's the official research sprint checklist? I want to schedule some user interviews and follow the playbook for the first sprint. Any recommended templates?
Robin Alvarez: The canonical research checklist is in Notion: Product > Playbooks > Research Sprints. Theres an "Interview guide" template and a "Synthesis notes" page. Ill share a copied template in the channel so you can duplicate it. Also ping me if you want a buddy on interview plan reviews.
Samir Patel: Pro tip — we put recruitment screener + consent language into the Notion template so legal has already approved it. If you need a recruiting contact, cc @Samir and I'll loop in our research recruiter.
onboard-bot: :sparkles: Welcome Maria Lopez! Onboarding checklist created. Please complete: device setup, security training, and join #design-system.
Maria Lopez: Thanks all — I'll finish the checklist today and book a few 1:1s. Appreciate the speedy help!
